explication: This repository is a curated collection of Codex plugins. The principal workflow is: a Codex user selects a plugin capability, its skill or MCP surface dispatches domain work, and the plugin returns an artifact, analysis, visualization, or integration result. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime implementations—analytics, security, OpenAI key confirmation, Google Docs routing, and NGS execution—while retaining major documented plugin families. Several documented bundles are represented only at the plugins root because their implementation was not sampled.
